validity.researcher_notes: This is a real, physically-built branch pipeline, not a phantom entity. Beihai Road & Port Construction Investment Development Co. (北海市路港建设投资开发有限公司, a state-owned Beihai municipal company and co-investor via joint venture 广投北海燃气公司) published two of its own project announcements on its official news page (gxbhlg.com): one dated 2024-04-02 describing a pipeline gas-in/replacement test completed 2024-03-29 on the '东港支线12.6Km管道' running from PipeChina's Baisha gas transmission station (国家管网白沙输气站) to the Langgen distribution station (榄根分输站); a second, syndicated to nengyuanquan.com and dated 2024-08-22, describing the official commissioning/first-customer gas-on event of 2024-08-19, naming the first connected customers (新福兴, 长利 — both glass manufacturers in the industrial park) and giving full specs (12.6 km, 4 MPa design pressure, ~2亿 RMB investment, ~2 bcm/y capacity at full load). Both articles trace to the same corporate source (the project developer itself), so this is a single strong primary-source origin rather than two fully independent outlets — tier is medium, not high. A separate, genuinely independent record — a 2025-06-27 procurement notice on the Guangxi Investment Group's own e-procurement platform (gigeps.com) soliciting feasibility-study consulting for a FOLLOW-ON gas project in the same '北海铁山东港产业园' (a new ~5km line + city-gate station, separate scope/budget from this 12.6km branch) — independently corroborates that this specific industrial park has an active, ongoing gas-pipeline buildout, consistent with P7665 being real infrastructure rather than a GEM-only entity. I could not reach the GEM-cited fgw.gxzf.gov.cn (Guangxi Development and Reform Commission) URL at all from this sandbox (ConnectTimeout via curl, WebFetch ECONNREFUSED, and even a direct-IP retry) — this reads as a network/geoblock limitation of the research environment, not evidence the source is fake, since an independent primary source describing the identical project (same 12.6km length, same Baisha->Langgen route, same 4MPa pressure) exists and is reachable.

PipelineType=transmission is plausible and consistent with the evidence: this is a high-pressure feeder ('支线管道'/branch pipeline) running from a PipeChina national trunk transmission station (国家管网白沙输气站) to a distribution station (榄根分输站) at a design pressure of 4 MPa — well above typical city/local distribution-network pressures (commonly <1.6 MPa in China) and consistent with transmission-grade pipe, even though it is a short branch rather than a long-haul trunk. Not reclassifying.

validity.researcher_notes: Length: the sheet's own government source could not be reached, but the project developer's own two disclosures both independently state length as '12.6公里/12.6Km' — a small, material discrepancy from GEM's recorded LengthKnown=12.3 km (~2.4% off, not a rounding artifact of common unit-conversion — plain km-to-km). Recommend correcting to 12.6. Pressure: GEM's Pressure=4 MPa matches the source's '设计压力4兆帕' exactly — confirmed, no change (also staged as a fill below since the ref cell was blank). Capacity: GEM's Capacity=1.76 bcm/y is in the same order of magnitude as the source's '满负荷运营状态下...年供气量可达近20亿立方米' (~2 bcm/y at full operation) but not an exact match (~12% off) — the press-release phrasing ('nearly 2 billion') is an approximation, so I'm not forcing a change, but flagging that GEM's more precise 1.76 figure isn't independently confirmed by anything I could read (it may come from the unreachable government filing, which would be a more authoritative source than the press release for this figure). Cost: GEM's SegmentCost=230,000,000 RMB (2024) vs the press release's '总投资约2亿元' (~200,000,000 RMB) — again same order of magnitude, ~13% off, likely just the press release rounding down; not forcing a change but flagging as unresolved. StartMonth1: this field currently carries NO ref at all (MISSING_REF) and StartYear1=2024/StartMonth1=1 (January) is unsupported by anything found — evidence instead shows two distinct 2024 milestones on this exact project (pipe gas-in/pressure test completed 2024-03-29; official commissioning + first industrial customers connected 2024-08-19), neither of which is January. See fills for the proposed correction to August 2024, which best matches 'pipeline placed in service.' None of this rises to an existence or classification problem — the pipe is real and correctly typed — but the spec/date precision needs correcting.

fills.researcher_notes: Existing value Pressure=4 MPa is confirmed exactly: nengyuanquan.com states '设计压力4兆帕' (design pressure 4 MPa) for this same 12.6km Baisha->Langgen branch; gxbhlg.com's account of the commissioning test also reports pressures being raised to 3.8 MPa during the leak-test phase, consistent with a 4 MPa design/rated pressure. Ref cell was previously blank (MISSING_REF); now filled.

Proposing a CORRECTION, not a plain confirmation, so flagging UNRESOLVED for human review rather than a clean REFS_ADDED. Current StartYear1=2024/StartMonth1=1 has no ref at all (MISSING_REF) and I found no evidence of a January 2024 event. Instead: nengyuanquan.com (2024-08-22, sourced to the project developer) reports the pipeline's official commissioning/first-gas-to-customers event as 2024-08-19 ('8月19日，北海铁山东港产业园天然气支线管道项目...正式启动调试通气工作'), naming the first two connected industrial customers. A separate, earlier milestone — completion of the pipeline's own gas-replacement/pressure test — occurred 2024-03-29 per gxbhlg.com (both dates are 2024, matching GEM's StartYear1). Recommend setting StartMonth1=8 (the 'placed in service / first gas to customers' milestone, the closest match to what StartYear/StartMonth typically records) rather than the currently unsupported January value; a researcher should confirm which milestone GEM intends before pasting this in, since March vs August is a real choice between two documented dates, not a discovery of a phantom one.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status=operating is confirmed current and correct — this is not a stale/dormant proposed or under-construction row. Newest independent evidence found is dated 2024-08-22 (nengyuanquan.com), describing the pipeline's official commissioning on 2024-08-19 with named industrial customers (新福兴, 长利) already receiving pipeline gas, i.e. actively in service. Searched for anything more recent (2025-2026) reporting an outage, expansion, or status change for this specific branch; found none — the only newer activity in this immediate area (北海铁山东港产业园) is a 2025-06-27 procurement notice for a SEPARATE follow-on project (new ~5km line + gate station), which does not affect this segment's own operating status. No dormancy rule applies since the pipe is confirmed in active service, not proposed/shelved.

summary: P7665 (Hepu Baisha->Tieshan Donggang branch, Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network) is real and correctly classified/operating (confirmed via independent project-developer disclosures the GEM sheet doesn't cite, since its own cited fgw.gxzf.gov.cn ref was unreachable from this environment); flagged spec concerns on LengthKnown (12.3 vs sourced 12.6km), StartMonth1 (unsupported Jan 2024, evidence points to Aug 2024 commissioning), and unresolved rounding gaps on Capacity/SegmentCost, plus added a verified ref for the previously-blank Pressure cell.
